rationale: User ruling 2026-09-18: put the tiebreak lane (秤砣线) live and pause every other strategy -- closed, not deleted. A paused lane still compiles, records its decisions and writes the evidence the ledger and the fits read; only its sends are held (basket BUYs end failed with strategy_lane_paused:basket on their event; the two sell lanes are skipped by the daemon). Read fresh before every send. Missing file = every lane enabled; unreadable file = every lane paused. Charter 146.

basket.note: Every BUY the basket compile mints: seat, top-up, charter 143 completion, charter 145 TAF entry.

certain_win_recycle.note: Charter 100: the 0.998 sell of a won position. Won positions settle at 1.000 on their own while paused.

mis_bought_leg_exit.note: Charter 144: the sell-back of legs bought outside the completion rule.

tiebreak.note: 秤砣线 v2.1 (charter 146, user ruling 2026-09-18 升级到v2.1,并记录特征): at a stage's first decision, the model's mode bucket priced 0.40-0.60 by the market's normalised mid AND quoted both sides at most 3 cents wide -> buy that bucket, stake_usdc FOK at the walked ask, once per station-day. Features (market move since the previous decision, spread, depth) are recorded on every evaluation row, not traded on. v2 / v1 selectable by rule.
